answer.answer: The archive holds more than one figure for AAPL's fiscal period ending 2007-09-29 (period 2006-10-01 to 2007-09-29), and ST-EVA has not selected between them. Two observations are held, both SOURCE_REPORTED and both UNVERIFIABLE (no cross-check recorded for either): (1) USD 24,006,000,000, from us-gaap:SalesRevenueNet as filed in the 10-K, accession 0001193125-09-214859, source-declared available 2009-10-27 (obsarch_ddb4af888ab3c6be910c0f9e); and (2) USD 24,578,000,000, from the same us-gaap:SalesRevenueNet concept as filed in the 10-K/A, accession 0001193125-10-012091, source-declared available 2010-01-25 (obsarch_6383b6a9892d72ff26aab02a). Both observations carry a PARTIAL mapping to the revenue metric, so neither is recorded as an exact expression of the metric, and both sit within a concept-mapping break window the evidence does not explain. I am not choosing between the two figures: the archive's own ambiguity record gives the reason as unexplained, noting that the source endpoint aggregates dimension members without returning the member, so the aggregate is not identifiable from the evidence held. The 2007 revenue history returns exactly these two points and is not truncated, so there is no further point in the series to break the tie.
uncertainties: Two conflicting revenue figures are held for the same period (24,006,000,000 vs 24,578,000,000 USD) with resolution recorded as NO_WINNER_SELECTED; the disagreement is not settled.
Neither observation has any recorded cross-check (validation_status UNVERIFIABLE, validation lists empty), so the evidence cannot establish which figure is correct.
The reason for the conflict is recorded as NOT_EXPLAINED: the source endpoint aggregates dimension members without returning the member, so the aggregate is not identifiable from the evidence held.

Both mappings are PARTIAL rather than EXACT, and the period falls inside concept-mapping break windows the evidence does not explain; the comparison to figures from other periods is therefore not clean.
The evidence does not state which figure, if either, is the company's revenue for the period as presented on the face of the filings.
